promotion_policy: One league-market can be promoted on its own. Promotion requires a prospective season that was not used to choose features, distributions, or position splits. 2023-2025 are examined. No model is promoted from this study.

windows.train: games before 1 August of the calibration season
windows.calibration: the season before the test season, Platt only

sportsbook.note: Declared 4.5, 49.5, and 39.5 lines are research lines. They are not sportsbook prices.

eligibility.note: FBS has no weekly roster, so players missing from the box score stay unknown and are not added.
